ORAL ORDER 3 26-12-2025 Heard the parties.

2. The petitioner has preferred this application for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Marhowrah P. S. Case No. 445 of 2019 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419,
420, 467, 468, 471, 406 of IPC.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
3. According to the prosecution, Awadhesh Rai (co- accused) applied for a loan of Rs. 2,00,000/-
which was sanctioned by the Uttar Bihar Gramin Bank, Mubarakpur (Saran).
Saryug Prasad and Ram Lagan Sah (petitioner) stood as guarantors, and several LIC bonds were submitted as security by them.
When, Awadhesh Rai failed to repay the loan instalments, then the bank initiated the process to encash the mortgaged LIC bonds.
It is further alleged that the LIC bonds which were submitted by them were found fake, leading to the present case.

Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.79742 of 2025(3) dt.26-12-2025 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is quite innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
Entire prosecution case is false, concocted and after thought.
He further submits that a loan was sanctioned in favour of lonee-Awadhesh Rai by Uttar Bihar Gramin Bank in which informant is Branch Manager and in that loan petitioner was one of the guarantor.
In view of non-payment of loan amount, case was instituted.

He further submits that aforesaid loan amount of Rs. 2,00,000/- has been deposited by the lonee-Awadhesh Rai as per direction of a Co-ordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 23.08.2021 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 4287 of 2021.
This fact has been mentioned in para 11 of the bail application.

1 antecedent as stated in para 3 of bail petition.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

6. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts and considering the clean antecedent of the petitioner, let the petitioner, above named, be released on anticipatory bail in the event of arrest or surrender within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of this order, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/-
(Ten Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.79742 of 2025(3) dt.26-12-2025 Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Saran at Chapra in connection with Marhowrah P. S. Case No. 445 of 2019 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482 of BNSS.
